objective: Accelerate implementation and proof while continuously converting evidence into customer value, autonomy, reliability and product evolution on one canonical candidate.

rules: A coded feature with weak evidence outranks cosmetic expansion.
A repeated manual step becomes an automation candidate.
A repeated failure becomes an eval and prevention candidate.
A competitor delta becomes a customer-outcome eval before it becomes a feature.
Do not blindly rerun an unchanged deterministic failure.

requiredQuestions: Can we make it more autonomous?
Can the learning create additional customer value?
Can the same class of failure be prevented next time?

loops.purpose: Find the largest capability, proof or market gap.
Translate work into measurable manufacturing, cost, compliance, reliability or user-effort outcomes.
Converge changes onto the trust spine and reusable operating architecture.
Deliver the smallest end-to-end vertical slice that can be verified.
Predict failure and outcome before customer-visible execution.
Attack authority, tenant isolation, audit, identity and unsafe autonomy.
Prove behaviour from small manufacturers through 10000+ employee multi-site environments.
Remove clicks, questions, training burden and configuration effort.
Convert recurring implementation and support touch into safe machine-executable handling.
Classify blockers quickly, preserve evidence and route to an equivalent proof lane without weakening gates.
Bind claims to exact candidate evidence, hosted behaviour, restart and recovery.
Turn verified failures and wins into evals, skills, runbooks and prevention candidates.
Attack VECTOR from a separately isolated test product without granting Northstar VECTOR production authority.
